# Elmify

> Elmify is an AI application platform (in English, Azerbaijani, and Russian) for funded master's degrees (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes) and scholarships across 50+ countries, with Bachelor's degree support coming soon. Where traditional agencies either deliver low-effort applications to a few partner universities or hand files to student mentors prompting ordinary ChatGPT, Elmify reads official university and funder regulations in 40+ local languages, checks student grades, Bachelor's ECTS credits, language scores, citizenship, and fee budgets (in AZN, EUR, GBP, and USD) against every rule with sentence-level source links, builds tailored zero-fabrication academic CVs, programme-tailored motivation letters, scholarship essays, and referee briefs, and autofills portals in your browser.

## Platform Scope & Languages
- **Supported Languages:** Available across three full-featured language versions in Azerbaijan and worldwide: English (`https://elmify.com/`), Azerbaijani (`https://elmify.com/az`), and Russian (`https://elmify.com/ru`).
- **Live Today:** Taught and research master's programmes (`MSc`, `MA`, `LLM`, `MRes`, `1-year` and `2-year` master's, `60`, `90`, and `120 ECTS` second-cycle programmes) and master's-level scholarships across 50+ countries worldwide (Europe, the UK, North America, Turkey, and Asia).
- **Coming Soon:** Bachelor's (undergraduate) degree and scholarship support will be done soon.

## Main Pages & Language Editions
- [Elmify Homepage (English)](https://elmify.com/): Overview of how Elmify matches funded master's programmes and scholarships across 50+ countries with sentence-level source links and tailored documents.
- [Elmify Ana Səhifə (Azərbaycan dili)](https://elmify.com/az): 50+ ölkədə təqaüdlü magistratura proqramları, Dövlət Proqramı (2022–2028), HTP və fərdiləşdirilmiş sənəd hazırlığı.
- [Главная страница Elmify (Русский язык)](https://elmify.com/ru): Магистратура и стипендии в 50+ странах мира (Госпрограмма Азербайджана, HTP, Европа, Великобритания, Северная Америка и Азия).
- [How the AI Works](https://elmify.com/#how): Four-step verification workflow from official university regulations across 50+ countries to tailored document preparation and glass-box portal autofill.
- [Scholarship Coverage Table](https://elmify.com/#about): Comparison of flagship national and bilateral awards (Dövlət Proqramı, HTP / Stipendium Hungaricum, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Swedish Institute, Chevening, NL Scholarship) plus 5 low-competition scholarship categories (automatic tuition waivers, regional income-based grants, multilateral bloc funds, local-language foundations, and departmental RA/TA assistantships).
- [Product Walkthrough](https://elmify.com/#product): Real screens from the student dashboard, application board, document workspace, and counsellor messaging.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://elmify.com/#faq): Answers on Azerbaijan launch, pricing, degree scope (Master's live, Bachelor's coming soon, PhD excluded), source verification, and data privacy.

## Scholarship & Funder References
- [Azerbaijan State Program (Dövlət Proqramı 2022–2028)](https://dp.edu.az/): Full tuition, monthly living stipend, return flights, insurance, and visa coverage for Azerbaijani citizens admitted to priority master's programmes at top global universities.
- [Intergovernmental Scholarship Programs (HTP Azerbaijan & Stipendium Hungaricum)](https://htp.edu.az/): Dual-portal (`htp.edu.az` + `DreamApply`) bilateral scholarships for Hungary, China, Romania, and partner countries.
- [Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/opportunities/opportunities-for-individuals/students/erasmus-mundus-joint-masters): Full tuition waiver and €1,400/month stipend for integrated 120 ECTS European master's degrees.
- [DAAD Study Scholarships](https://www.daad.de/en/Studying-in-Germany/scholarships/): €934/month stipend, insurance, and travel allowance for full-time postgraduate study in Germany.
- [Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)](https://si.se/en/apply/scholarships/swedish-institute-scholarships-for-global-professionals/): Full tuition and SEK 12,000/month living stipend for master's programmes in Sweden (Azerbaijan eligible).
- [Chevening Scholarships](https://www.chevening.org/scholarships/): Full UK tuition, monthly stipend, and return flights for 1-year taught master's degrees in the UK.
- [NL Scholarship](https://www.studyinnl.org/finances/nl-scholarship): €5,000 first-year grant for non-EEA master's applicants at participating Dutch universities.

## Application Entry Points
- [Sign Up Free (EN)](https://app.elmify.com/signup/?lang=en): Create a free student account in English.
- [Pulsuz Qeydiyyat (AZ)](https://app.elmify.com/signup/?lang=az): Azərbaycan dilində pulsuz tələbə hesabı yaradın.
- [Бесплатная регистрация (RU)](https://app.elmify.com/signup/?lang=ru): Создайте бесплатный аккаунт студента на русском языке.
- [Log In](https://app.elmify.com/accounts/login/): Sign in to an existing student or counsellor workspace.
- [Book a Student & Parent Walkthrough](https://app.elmify.com/demo/?audience=student): Schedule a 1-on-1 walkthrough of funded master's matching, hidden funding layers, and the browser extension co-pilot.
